crossRefs.note: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.
Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.
Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they…
but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.
For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted…
But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from…
and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south…
from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five…
I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I…
The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
“ ‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

translations.web: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.
translations.bsb: Ashdod, with its towns and villages; Gaza, with its towns and villages, as far as the Brook of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.
